SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
WEDNESDAY - SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 - 01:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
PUBLIC ADVISORY: THIS MEETING WILL BE CONDUCTED IN A HYBRID MODEL WITH BOTH IN-PERSON ATTENDANCE AND VIRTUAL PARTICIPATION.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda packet is available at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st Floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours as posted. Public materials received after posting of the agenda will also be available for public inspection. For assistance, contact the Office of the City Clerk at city_clerk@cerritos.gov or (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council may reorder agenda items by majority vote of members present.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov/agendas or the City’s YouTube channel , on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public comment may be provided in person, remotely via Zoom, or in writing as described below. Public comment on business agenda items will be heard during consideration of Agenda Item 4.
Remote/teleconference (Zoom) participation :
PLEASE ENSURE YOUR ZOOM SOFTWARE IS UPDATED TO PROVIDE LIVE COMMENTS
Meeting ID: 897 8691 1692
Smart Phone or Computer (Zoom App required): https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89786911692
Phone Call-In: (669) 900-6833
To request to speak via Zoom, join or call in at the meeting start time and use the “Raise Hand” feature or press *9 by phone during the item on which you wish to speak. Press *6 to unmute when prompted.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Written comments may be submitted by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or delivered to the Office of the City Clerk no later than 10:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. Timely comments will be distributed to the legislative body and retained as part of the official record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Closed Session Report (September 30, 2026 Closed Session Items, as listed above)
Information regarding the Closed Session report will be available at the Office of the City Clerk within 24 hours following the conclusion of the City Council meeting, and a verbal report will be provided at the next regular City Council/Successor Agency meeting, on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes, for the meeting in which said action is reported.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 30, 2026, 1:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT
CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA AND
VIA ZOOM TELECONFERENCE, MEETING ID# 897 8691 1692.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 1:12 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Johnson.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Jennifer Hong
  Councilmember Sophia M. Tse
  Councilmember Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Lynda Provido Johnson

4.  Public Comments (Special Meeting Agenda Item 5 Only)

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Seeing none, the Mayor declared the
  public comments period closed.

5.  Closed Session

  Current Wednesday, September 30, 2026 Closed Session Agenda

  Pam Lee, City Attorney, announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session
  to discuss Item 12A, 12B, and 12C, as listed on the Closed Session agenda. An
  announcement regarding any reportable action resulting from the Closed Session will
  be available at the Office of the City Clerk within 24 hours following the conclusion of
  the City Council meeting, and a verbal report will be provided at the next regular City
  Council/Successor Agency meeting, on any reportable action taken.
